functions.does: The handwheel works the saw: a pin in the 24 tooth gear on the handwheel's axle is a crank that pushes the toothed blade back and forth, and a link from the blade's far end rocks the tilted frame with the crown gear on top.
functions.source: book: steps 6-8 (handwheel, gear with its pin, blade) and 9 (links and frame); what the crank and links do inferred from the model file, as the book draws no arrows

functions.does: The crown gear on top of the tilted frame turns freely on its axle, like a saw blade.
functions.source: inferred: from the model file and sub-step 5 (crown gear on an axle with two bushes); the book doesn't say
